description_en: Configures third-party channels for multiple agent runtimes in batches, supports delivering different channel configurations to different runtimes, and returns the configuration result for each configuration item
description_zh: 批量为多个Agent运行时配置三方通道，支持为不同运行时下发不同的通道配置，并逐条返回每个配置项的配置结果
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center batch-config-runtime-channel --runtime-type CloudDesktop --agent-platform ENTERPRISE --agent-provider OpenClaw --channel-configs '[{"Config":"{\"appKey\":\"testKey\",\"appSecret\":\"testSecret\"}","ConfigMode":"Simple","RuntimeId":"ecd-xgads","Code":"dingtalk-connector"}]' --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchConfigRuntimeChannel

parameters.help_en: The agent runtime type, such as CloudDesktop (Cloud Desktop)
parameters.help_zh: Agent运行时类型，例如 CloudDesktop（云电脑）
parameters.name: runtime_type

parameters.help_en: The agent platform, such as ENTERPRISE. If the value is invalid, the error code InvalidParameter.AgentPlatform is returned
parameters.help_zh: Agent平台，例如 ENTERPRISE。取值不合法时返回错误码 InvalidParameter.AgentPlatform
parameters.name: agent_platform

parameters.help_en:
The agent provider.

JVS Computer: Specify OpenClaw.
OpenClaw: Specify OpenClaw.
Hermes Agent: Specify HermesAgent
parameters.help_zh:
Agent提供商。

JVS Computer：填入OpenClaw。
OpenClaw：填入OpenClaw。
Hermes Agent：填入HermesAgent
parameters.name: agent_provider

fields.help_en: The third-party channel code, such as dingtalk-connector (DingTalk), feishu (Lark), and wecom (WeCom). System channel codes are case-insensitive. Configuring wechat and jvsclaw is not supported. If these values are passed, the entire request fails and the error code ChannelConfig.NotSupported is returned
fields.help_zh: 三方通道编码，例如 dingtalk-connector（钉钉）、feishu（飞书）、wecom（企业微信）。系统通道编码不区分大小写。不支持配置 wechat 和 jvsclaw，传入时整个请求失败并返回错误码 ChannelConfig.NotSupported
fields.name: code

fields.help_en:
The JSON string for channel configuration.

Simple mode: only appKey and appSecret are allowed.
Custom mode: all configuration items required for the channel under the current agent provider must be included.

If the string is not valid JSON, the error code InvalidParameter.ValueInvalid is returned
fields.help_zh:
通道配置 JSON 字符串。

Simple 模式：仅允许包含 appKey 和 appSecret。
Custom 模式：须包含该通道在当前 Agent 提供商下要求的全部配置项。

不是合法 JSON 时返回错误码 InvalidParameter.ValueInvalid
fields.name: config

fields.help_en:
The configuration mode. Valid values:

Simple: simple configuration mode.
Custom: custom configuration mode
fields.help_zh:
配置模式。取值：

Simple：简单配置模式。
Custom：自定义配置模式
fields.name: config_mode

fields.help_en:
The channel name.

If this parameter is not specified, the system automatically uses the code as the name
fields.help_zh:
通道名称。

如果不填写，系统会自动使用Code作为名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The agent runtime ID. The ID mappings are as follows:

JVS Computer: the JVS Computer ID, in the format of jvs-xxxx.
OpenClaw: the cloud desktop ID, in the format of ecd-xxxx.
Hermes Agent: the Hermes Agent ID, in the format of jvs-xxxx
fields.help_zh:
Agent 运行时 ID，ID 对应关系如下：

JVS Computer：JVS Computer ID，格式如 jvs-xxxx。
OpenClaw：云电脑 ID，格式如 ecd-xxxx。
Hermes Agent：Hermes Agent ID，格式如 jvs-xxxx
fields.name: runtime_id

parameters.help_en: The list of channel configurations. A maximum of 200 items are supported. Each configuration item specifies an agent runtime and the third-party channel to be configured for it. Different channel configurations can be delivered to different runtimes. Multiple configuration items for the same runtime are processed sequentially
parameters.help_zh: 通道配置列表，最多 200 条。每个配置项指定一个 Agent 运行时及其要配置的三方通道，可为不同运行时下发不同的通道配置；同一运行时的多个配置项按顺序依次处理
parameters.name: channel_configs

Data.description_en: The list of batch configuration results. Each channel configuration item corresponds to one result
Data.description_zh: 批量配置结果列表，每个通道配置项对应一条结果

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the configuration fails. This parameter is returned only when Success is false
ErrorCode.description_zh: 配置失败时的错误码，仅当 Success 为 false 时返回

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the configuration fails. This parameter is returned only when Success is false
Message.description_zh: 配置失败时的错误描述，仅当 Success 为 false 时返回

Success.description_en:
Specifies whether the channel configuration item is configured successfully. Valid values:

true: The configuration is successful.
false: The configuration failed. For the cause of the failure, see ErrorCode and Message
Success.description_zh:
该通道配置项是否配置成功。取值：

true：配置成功。
false：配置失败，失败原因见 ErrorCode 和 Message

RequestId.title_en: 请求ID，用于标识请求的唯一 ID
RequestId.title_zh: 请求ID，用于标识请求的唯一 ID

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of configuration results, which is the same as the number of configuration items in ChannelConfigs
TotalCount.description_zh: 配置结果条数，与 ChannelConfigs 中的配置项数量一致
